The '''Royal District''' of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] was the primary district of the royal family and prominent nobles that ran the government of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]].

==History==
Originally, the Royal District fanned out from the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]], the massive residence of the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|Tetan Monarchy]]. The Royal District underwent massive changes after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], with the Iron Citadel disappearing from the landscape and replaced by a new, resplendent [[Tetan Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]]. Bordering the [[Core District/Legends|Core District]], the [[Great Library of Cinnagar/Legends|Great Library of Cinnagar]] was located right on the border.<ref name="NoP" />
